data.name: Sushen
data.gender_notes: Sushen is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Sushen refers to the lord of the Himalayas, a symbol of strength, wisdom, and grace. In Hindu mythology, Sushen is considered the god of fertility, rain, and the harvest. He is often depicted as a tall, powerful figure with multiple arms, holding a conch shell, a discus, and a mace. The name Sushen carries the meaning “Lord of the Himalayas” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit. Parents who choose Sushen usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the himalayas and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sushen is a name deeply rooted in Hindu spirituality. It represents the divine power and grace of the natural world, and is a reminder of the interconnectedness of all things. For those seeking a name with deep spiritual significance, Sushen is an excellent choice.
data.etymology: Sushen belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the Himalayas.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sushen total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
